added.member: UI documents: filter and backdrop-filter functions
added.summary: filter takes contrast(), invert(), sepia(), opacity() and drop-shadow() beside blur(), brightness(), grayscale(), hue-rotate() and saturate(), applied in the order written; drop-shadow() follows the alpha of what is drawn, not the box. backdrop-filter takes the same set over the backdrop.
Layer materials for a CSS colour matrix (over sRGB-encoded straight colour, clamped) and a drop shadow of the layer's alpha, and a colour matrix over a backdrop.

fixed.summary: blur() is CSS's standard deviation (it was taken as the layer blur's radius, half as soft), grayscale(), saturate(), brightness() and hue-rotate() use Filter Effects' matrices over sRGB-encoded colour (they mixed in linear light), and blur() with a colour function draws both (the colour function replaced the blur). backdrop-filter's saturate() and brightness() are the same matrices. Reference frames css-paint-1280 and css-paint-390 moved.
